review_improvement: Makes the destructive scope finite and auditable while preserving the exact12-hour random-write performance coverage and requiring wear/recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Random write without filename and size has no safe execution boundary. At512 bytes, a long time-based run can produce large write amplification and reach a steady state unlike a short sample; duration and range therefore affect both result and endurance. QD1 emphasizes latency, so full percentile data matters more than a headline average. Target serial plus path prevents device-renumbering mistakes, and final SMART/endurance plus reprovision evidence is required before reuse. Automatic repetition doubles wear and is prohibited.
